YouTube Long-Form Coach v1.0.0

- Launches a coach focused on long-form YouTube (8–30+ min) content best practices for 2026 algorithm reality.
- Covers all key aspects: packaging (title, thumbnail, first 30s as a unit), optimal long-form structure, retention engineering, upload cadence, and niche/monetization strategy.
- Addresses when to pivot or persist, how to judge channel viability, and specifics on CTR, AVD, session time, subscriber metrics, and retention graph analysis.
- Provides distinct triggers for YouTube long-form scenarios; does not engage for Shorts, livestreams, or podcast clip strategies.
